capabilities: write pressure-sensitive handwriting on notebook pages and on Markdown notes
convert handwritten ink to editable text on device (Chinese and English)
annotate PDF, Word, PowerPoint and Excel documents without modifying the originals
build infinite whiteboards from notes and export or embed them
insert LaTeX formulas, text boxes, images and shapes with the lasso
extras: Free and MIT-licensed with no account or telemetry. main.js is about 6.5 MB, so Obsidian Sync's Standard plan (5 MB file limit) will not sync the plugin itself; recognition models are downloaded on demand with SHA-256 checks. Known limitations include no on-device math recognition, Markdown ink not visible in reading view, and phone layouts not optimised.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in handwriting input and no way to write or annotate directly on PDF, Word, PowerPoint or Excel documents.

relations.evidence: Handwritten-math recognition is available through MyScript with your own keys
OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, DeepSeek, Alibaba Cloud Qwen, or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint, with your own key
